seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Miami Gardens, FL 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Miami Gardens, FL: a toy giveaway at Lester Brown Park and The First Christmas Spectacular at Betty T. Ferguson Complex.
lede: Miami Gardens does Christmas with giving: a free toy giveaway at Dr. Lester B. Brown Park and a Christmas show at the Betty T. Ferguson Recreational Complex.
celebrates: Miami Gardens is Florida's largest majority Black city, and its holiday listings lean toward community and giving. A Gifts From the Heart toy giveaway fills Dr. Lester B. Brown Park on December 19, and the Betty T. Ferguson Recreational Complex hosts The First Christmas Spectacular that evening. The city's parks and recreation department runs the parks, and its calendar lists community events through the season.
lastyear: Rally did not find a published 2025 holiday recap from the City of Miami Gardens, so this page only lists 2026 events that hosts have posted. The city's own calendar currently shows November events such as Legal Aid Day and Military Mondays at the Betty T. Ferguson Recreational Complex.
facts: Miami Gardens was incorporated on May 13, 2003, and had a population of 111,640 in 2020. The name comes from Florida State Road 860, also called Miami Gardens Drive. The city is home to Hard Rock Stadium, and its neighborhoods include Carol City, Norland, Scott Lake and Bunche Park.
trains: Tri-Rail lists an Opa-locka station among its stops, and Brightline leaves from MiamiCentral in downtown Miami. Metrorail's Green Line ends at Palmetto station, 7701 NW 79th Avenue. For a train day, the Gold Coast Railroad Museum in Miami has the presidential car Ferdinand Magellan and a narrow gauge train ride.

faq: Where is the toy giveaway in Miami Gardens?
Gifts From the Heart is at Dr. Lester B. Brown Park, 19405 NW 32nd Ave, on Saturday, December 19, from noon to 3 pm. It is free, with free tickets on Eventbrite, one per child.
Where is The First Christmas Spectacular?
At the Betty T. Ferguson Recreational Complex, 3000 NW 199th St, on Saturday, December 19, from 5 to 7 pm. Tickets start at $13.39.
Miami Gardens had a population of 111,640 in 2020 and is Florida's most populous city with a majority African American population.
